title: Enforce exact-SHA, evidence-tiered Final Review closure packets and false-green score caps

acceptanceCriteria.description: A versioned strict packet schema records task, exact target, acceptance-to-evidence links, architecture owners, evidence taxonomy, migration/rollback status, live status, and owned caveats.
The validator rejects malformed packets, exact-SHA mismatches, target-branch mismatches, missing risk evidence, and non-packet SHA drift after review.
Risk profiles encode auth/scope, rate/label, provider durable-job, billing/inventory/lifecycle, timing/live, and governance proof requirements.
Static or breadcrumb evidence cannot satisfy behavioral assertions or required integration, adversarial, failure-injection, E2E, or live classes.
Machine-readable closure outcomes cap Critical/High or source-of-truth bypasses at 74, missing required proof at 88, SHA-invalid packets at 0, and Hermes eligibility to complete claims above 90.
CI, PR, architecture, contributor, checklist, and task-template workflows link the exact-SHA packet and canonical validator.
PS-333/350/351-like static false greens fail, every risk profile has a complete passing fixture, and stale SHA, source-of-truth bypass, score thresholds, and explicit live blocks are covered.
The change is offline governance infrastructure only and does not modify product behavior, providers, billing, inventory, labels, shipped/cancelled data, or production state.

oldOwners.path: Trello/Hermes prose status and reviewer score

sotBypass.details: Closure policy, risk requirements, score caps, and exact-SHA decisions live only in the canonical validator; CI, docs, Trello, and Hermes are thin consumers.

evidence.proves: The strict schema, all six complete risk-profile fixtures, and 0/74/88/100 outcomes execute offline and pass.
Static-only PS-333/350/351-like claims, wrong SHA/branch, source-of-truth bypass, unmet High work, score 90, and unverified live fixtures cannot produce a false green.
Injected malformed structure, stale identity, missing tiers, non-passing live evidence, and unresolved policy ownership are rejected or capped deterministically.
The packet matches the exact implementation SHA and target branch, and repository history after that SHA contains packet files only.
Package, CI, schema, docs, risk taxonomy, score-cap tokens, and mandatory guard-pack wiring remain present and offline.
All 38 mandatory source-of-truth, backend-truth, and offline safety guards passed with PS-429 included.
Backend and frontend strict TypeScript compilation passed.
The production frontend build completed successfully.
The PS-429 implementation commit contains only governance scripts, schema/docs/templates, package wiring, and CI wiring; no product or protected shipped/cancelled surface is present.
